skill2: ■ Activates at the start of battle. Affects self. Damage dealt to Shield ▲ 700.5% continuously.

caveats: ⚑ CADENCE: both skill1 blocks key off hitCount:100 rounds. Real-world proc rate is set by the MG's datamined cadence (rate_of_fire is a known-unreliable field) and the 300-round belt + 171f reload — a 100-round threshold means roughly one proc per third of a magazine. Wall-clock proc rate is UNVERIFIED.

⚑ TWO COUNTERS, ONE THRESHOLD: the kit distinguishes 'after 100 normal attack(s)' (skill1a) from 'after landing 100 normal attack(s)' (skill1b). Modeled as two independent hitCount:100 blocks, i.e. both fire on the same round. If the sim ever models misses on normal attacks, the LANDED counter would lag the FIRED counter and the two would desync.

⚑ RIDER CRIT: skill1b (112.37%) and the burst nuke (990.2%) are authored crit:true per the rider prior (riders crit at the caster's sheet rate). No core (the text never says 'core strike damage'). noRange is engine-automatic and not authored.

⚑ noFb: NOT set on either damage rider (default OFF, measured-only). The burst 990.2% is cast-timed and should land pre-FB by timing; skill1b's 112.37% takes FB by timing. If popup reads show the burst nuke carrying/not carrying the +50% FB major, pin noFb from that.

ELEMENT GATE: elemAdvantageDamagePct is only live when the caster actually has elemental advantage. rei-ayanami is Fire, so on the Fire scope-lock boss this buff contributes ZERO — it is a real mechanic that happens to be inert on the graded fixture. Do not delete it on an 'it moves nothing' reading.

TRIGGER IDENTITY: skill2b reads 'when entering Burst stage 3' → stageEnter:{stage:3} (fires when ANY ally casts a stage-3 burst), NOT burstCast. In a comp with a second Burst III unit this fires on that unit's cast too; keying it to burstCast would UNDER-credit.

SHIELD/TANDEM: the burst shield is offensively inert alone (no HP pool modeled) but is kept because it emits a shield event that fires teammates' 'shielded' triggers and satisfies requiresShielded gates.

The skill2 'Damage dealt to Shield ▲ 700.5%' line is a large multiplier that is fully unmodeled — the v1 boss has no shield phase and StatKey has no shield-damage channel. If a shielded boss is ever in scope this is the single biggest missing piece of this kit.

flags.estimate: hitCount 100 rounds each; at a nominal MG cadence the pair procs roughly every 100 rounds of the 300-round belt (~3 procs/magazine)
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #1: the threshold (100) is kit-stated and certain, but the wall-clock proc RATE derives from the datamined MG cadence (rate_of_fire is a known-unreliable field, and effective rate is frame-quantised to 60/ceil(60/nominal)) plus the 171f reload. The engine counts ROUNDS, which for hitsPerShot 1 equals trigger pulls.
flags.recipe: Record a solo fight and count skill1 popups (the 112.37% rider) per magazine; compare popups-per-belt against 300/100 = 3. If the observed count differs, the MG's effective pulls/sec (or a per-shot multi-hit) is off — fix the cadence, not the threshold.

flags.field: skill1[1] vs skill1[0] — 'landing' vs plain 'normal attack(s)' counters
flags.estimate: modeled as two independent counters with the same threshold, so both fire on the same round
flags.reasoning: The kit deliberately words the two headers differently (fired vs landed). v1 has no miss model for normal attacks, so the distinction currently collapses. If misses are ever modeled the LANDED counter lags and the elemental-advantage window would open BEFORE the rider hit.
flags.recipe: In footage, check whether the 112.37% popup and the elemental-advantage buff icon appear on the same shot every cycle or progressively desync over a long fight. Desync ⇒ split the thresholds / add a landing gate.

flags.estimate: both left UNSET (FB by timing, default ON); the burst nuke should land pre-FB purely from burstCast timing
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #6: per-kit noFb is measured-only and must never be set unmeasured. Rule 9 says burst-cast damage is FB-exempt by TIMING, which the engine handles — authoring noFb:true would double-count the exemption if the engine already resolves the cast pre-FB.
flags.recipe: Read the burst popup value against final ATK × 9.902 × (buff state at cast). If the observed value carries a ×1.5 the timing path is not exempting it; if the rider popup lacks the ×1.5 inside a Full Burst window, set noFb on that rider.

flags.estimate: crit:true on both (caster sheet rate), core:false
flags.reasoning: Rider prior: function-damage riders crit at the caster's rate but take no core unless the text says 'core strike damage'. Neither line does. This is a prior, not a kit statement.
flags.recipe: Popup colour read: orange + crit icon on the 112.37% / 990.2% popups confirms crit; a red 'CORE HIT' tag would refute core:false.

flags.estimate: stageEnter{stage:3} — fires on any ally's stage-3 burst, not only rei's own
flags.reasoning: Trigger-identity rule: 'when entering Burst stage 3' is a stage-entry event, distinct from 'when using Burst Skill'. On a single-B3 comp the two are indistinguishable; they diverge only with a second Burst III unit, where burstCast would under-credit.
flags.recipe: Run a two-B3 fixture (rei + another Burst III) and check whether the 25.03% caster-ATK buffApply fires on the rotation where the OTHER B3 casts. If it does not, re-key to burstCast.

flags.estimate: zero contribution in v1 (no shield phase, no StatKey channel)
flags.reasoning: The magnitude (700.5%) is enormous, so this kit is likely balanced around shielded content. Omitting it is correct for the current partless/shieldless scope-lock boss but makes this override structurally incomplete for any shielded encounter.
flags.recipe: If shielded-boss content enters scope: add a shieldDamagePct StatKey + a shield-HP phase to the damage path, then re-fit rei against a shielded recording. Until then this line stays unmodeled by design.
